module "OutputsExpressionNoGraph.dsm"

product 0 Material "M_LiOutputsExpressionNoGraph" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 0.5, 0.25, 1), ParameterName="Tint", SortPriority=32) : float4 @L7:C9 "Tint"
  %1 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L11:C30 "EmissiveColor"
  %2 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.5), ParameterName="Glow", SortPriority=32) : float @L6:C9 "Glow"
  %3 = Multiply(%1, %2) : float3 @L11:C30 "EmissiveColor"
  %4 = Constant(Value=(2)) : float @L12:C40 "Opacity"
  %5 = Multiply(%2, %4) : float @L12:C33 "Opacity"
  %6 = Saturate(%5) : float @L12:C24 "Opacity"
  %7 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%3, Opacity=%6) @L3:C1
  sink %7
